messages.subject: Failed To Create Server
parts:
I posted my original question in the thread below and then realized it had been marked "Complete" so I wanted to make sure it was looked at as the previous thread did not address my issue.
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/O0p1CdyR-SM


I just started having this same problem. I do development on my app locally and then upload to a server to run for other users. I have had an app running without issue for some time. Just this morning...when i went to launch the app via the runnApp() command...I got the following erro in R.

runnApp("path_to_linux_server_location")

Listening on port 8100
Error in startServer("0.0.0.0", port, httpuvCallbacks) : 
Failed to create server

Same problem exists for example apps

runExample("01_hello")

Listening on port 8100
Error in startServer("0.0.0.0", port, httpuvCallbacks) : 
Failed to create server

When I run the custom app by pointing to the web server address in a browser...it displays properly with no errors.

Can anyone propose a possible explanation for this behavior?
